name: south-operation
description: מערכת המעבר דרומה - ניהול אריזה, שינוע וקליטה של ציוד

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @south/api && npm run build -w @south/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @south/shared && npm run test -w @south/api && npm run test -w @south/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @south/shared && npm run lint -w @south/api && npm run lint -w @south/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @south/api && npm run typecheck -w @south/web
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.demo: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run e2e:server -w @south/api" "npm run dev:demo -w @south/web"
